analysis_definition.clustering: scene-level clustering/stratification for pooled descriptive estimates
analysis_definition.estimability: NOT_ESTIMABLE when either arm lacks a valid allowlisted action
analysis_definition.multiplicity: FDR q=0.05 across six model × representation cells
analysis_definition.primary_metric: delta_flip = valid-action semantic flip rate minus valid-action neutral-control flip rate

rationale: Before outcomes, the approved design allocates 480 calls to retain all eligible scenes, all three models, both representations, both pair types and both arms. Full 20-scene K6 with both interfaces would require 960 calls; K5 separately tests interface effects.
